result:
Both `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` pass cleanly (13/13 tests, the printed `NotFoundHttpException`/`ValidationException` traces are just the framework's existing logging of correctly-handled 404/422 responses, matching the pre-existing test's behavior).

## Summary

Added a `published` draft/publish flag to posts, end to end:

- **`db/schema.ts`**: new `published` boolean column, `NOT NULL DEFAULT true` at the DB level so a migration (generated via `bun run db:make`, applied via `bun run db:migrate`) backfills existing posts as public; app-layer logic is what actually defaults new posts to draft.
- **`app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts`**: `PostPayloadSchema` gains `published: z.boolean().default(false)`, shared by create/update, satisfying "missing on create ⇒ draft."
- **`app/Models/Post.ts`**: added `'published'` to `fillable` so the edit form's `Post.update()` (mass-assignment protected, unlike `store()`'s `forceCreate()`) can write it.
- **`app/Http/Resources/PostResource.ts`**: exposes `published: boolean` on every serialized post.
- **`app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`**: `index()` and `search()` now share a `restrictToVisible()` helper that limits results to published posts, plus the signed-in viewer's own posts (drafts included); `show()` throws a generic `NotFoundHttpException` (404, no hint) when a non-author or guest requests an unpublished post.
- **`db/seeders/002_posts.ts`**: demo posts are seeded with `published: true` so the demo blog isn't empty.
- **`resources/js/pages/posts/New.tsx` and `Edit.tsx`**: added a "Published" checkbox wired to `form.data.published`.
- Regenerated `.guren/api-client.gen.ts` and `.guren/data.gen.ts` via `bun run codegen` so the new field is typed on the frontend.
- Added `tests/PostDrafts.test.ts`, a full-stack test suite (via `@guren/testing`'s `TestApp`, real DB fixtures) covering guest/second-user draft invisibility in the list, search, and direct post page (404), author access to their own draft and its edit form, create-defaults-to-draft, create-with-`published:true`, and edit-form publish/unpublish toggling.
